items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: the stint at Curtis May's (at The Nine) was -- it wasn't '38, it was '37.

ctx.x: Yes, after listening, I said that I migrated back to Tulsa from Kansas City in '39? It wasn't '39, it was '29. And the stint at Curtis May's (at The Nine) was -- it wasn't '38, it was '37. Before I went to San Diego.
How many clubs did Curtis Mos'by run?
Well, he had that one at that particular
